message: Director: Packet327 is attached. Review only Banishment Gate / PG200-B03 and PG200-B04 as directed by Return326, at current 823/25/0 authority. The packet preserves Return200’s sealed blockers, procedure and nine cases, and adds the current AC5 accepted/applied source: Faction Champion is explicitly a Humanoid targeting profile with a Wizard source route, but requires alliedStatus, positive standing, invocation permission and no aid ban. Decide whether that closes B03 as the nonmatching control without treating its conditional fixture as a campaign fact. For B04, reassess the touch-only, stationary type-change and already-claimed guard branches, plus living separate-body carriage, primary independent escape, dead-primary/corpse handling, and finite-summon expiry with genuine cargo. Distinguish accepted source-backed transitions from rule-only fixtures. If complete, issue a sealed Banishment Gate-only acceptance with exact bindings and application disposition. Otherwise seal a hold with each remaining blocker, minimum witness, any narrow subparts closed, and next identity. No acceptance/application is requested by this packet. Preserve unrelated decisions and all downstream gates.
